behavior.pattern: Non-modal, transient status notification, rendered inside a positioned stacking container. SCOPE DECISION (see TOAST-MATRIX.md §0): the stacking/viewport manager (Salt's ToastGroup, shadcn's Toaster/viewport, M3's implied single-corner queue) is IN SCOPE as a structural PART of this one chassis (structure.group), not a second top-level component — the same one-chassis-many-parts precedent dialog set for overlay+panel and select set for trigger+popup. Imperative triggering (`toast()`/a global singleton manager) is explicitly OUT of the reproduced surface: Salt's own architecture is the model for why this is a reasonable, sourced simplification rather than an invented shortcut — packages/lab/stories/toast-group/toast-group.stories.tsx shows ToastGroup is PURELY a presentational flex-column positioning wrapper, with the consumer owning an array of live toast entries via ordinary useState (no imperative API anywhere in Salt's own source). This chassis reproduces exactly that: `Toast` items each own their own internal auto-dismiss timer (a real, testable mechanism — the closest correct analogue to what the external sonner/Base UI toast managers do at the DOM-observable level), and `ToastGroup` is presentation-only; a consumer (the harness, standing in for a future imperative wrapper) manages the array. shadcn's OWN canonical 'sonner' is a thin wrapper: `Toaster` passes theming (`--normal-bg/-text/-border`, `--border-radius`), per-type icon overrides, and forwards `{...props}` straight into the external `sonner` npm package (confirmed NOT vendored in this clone: package.json:95 lists `"sonner": "^2.0.0"` as a dependency, and no `node_modules/sonner` directory exists anywhere under 3-source/ui). The actual toast-surface DOM contract, stacking math, swipe gesture and timer internals therefore live in an EXTERNAL, UNVENDORED package for the canonical column — a real, structural [R] boundary, the same class of boundary Radix was for behaviour-only reference in earlier components. As SUPPLEMENTARY, cross-checked (not canonical) evidence, this SAME shadcn monorepo ships a second, real, fully-inspectable 'base' style Toast (registry/bases/base/ui/toast.tsx, built on `@base-ui/react/toast` — also an external package, but the WRAPPER file's own CSS classes and data-attribute contract (`data-slot`, `data-expanded`, `data-limited`, `data-starting-style`, `data-ending-style`, `data-swipe-direction`, the `--toast-index`/`--toast-offset-y` custom-property stack) are real, committed source, not speculation — used here the same way alert.template.json used `registry/bases/radix/ui/alert.tsx`'s AlertAction as supplementary evidence for a part canonical new-york-v4 doesn't show directly.
